items.question: How soon after returning must I send travel receipts, and through which app?
items.answer:
You must send travel receipts within 30 days of your return through the finance app. [hb-04-chunk-0]
Source [hb-04-chunk-0]: "Business travel must be approved before booking. Travel receipts must be submitted within 30 days of your return, through finance app."
Source [hb-04-chunk-1]: "Keep original receipts for hotels and flights. Daily allowances follow national rules for each destination."

items.question: Koliko dana posle povratka šaljem račune za službeni put i kroz koju aplikaciju?
items.answer:
Odgovor iz prevedenih izvornih odlomaka:
[hb-04-chunk-0] Službeni put mora biti odobren pre rezervacije. Računi sa puta dostavljaju se u roku od 30 dana od povratka, preko finansijske aplikacije.

items.question: What must I use at each office entrance?
items.answer:
Your personal badge. [hb-09-chunk-0]
Source [hb-09-chunk-0]: "Office access requires your personal badge at every entrance. Lost badges must be reported to reception on same day."

items.question: Šta moram da koristim na svakom ulazu u kancelariju?
items.answer:
Odgovor iz prevedenih izvornih odlomaka:

items.question: How are parking spaces allocated and reserved?
items.answer:
Parking spaces are shared and reserved through the facilities app, on a first come, first served basis. [hb-09-chunk-1]
Source [hb-09-chunk-1]: "Parking is limited: spaces are shared and reserved through facilities app, first come, first served."

items.question: Kako se raspodeljuju i rezervišu parking mesta?
items.answer:
Odgovor iz prevedenih izvornih odlomaka:
[hb-09-chunk-1] Parking je ograničen: mesta se dele i rezervišu preko aplikacije za prostor, po redosledu prijave.

items.question: Which systems require multi-factor authentication?
items.answer:
Multi-factor authentication is required for email, VPN, and all internal tools. [hb-05-chunk-1]
Source [hb-05-chunk-1]: "Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is required for email, VPN and all internal tools."

items.question: Za koje sisteme je obavezna višefaktorska autentifikacija?
items.answer:
Odgovor iz prevedenih izvornih odlomaka:
[hb-05-chunk-1] Višefaktorska autentifikacija (MFA) obavezna je za imejl, VPN i sve interne alate.

items.question: Does unspent training money roll into another year?
items.answer:
No, unused budget does not carry over to next year.[hb-08-chunk-1]
Source [hb-08-chunk-1]: "Agree training with your manager before booking. Unused budget does not carry over to next year."

items.question: Da li se neiskorišćen budžet za obuke prenosi u sledeću godinu?
items.answer:
Odgovor iz prevedenih izvornih odlomaka:
[hb-08-chunk-1] Obuku dogovorite sa rukovodiocem pre rezervacije. Neiskorišćeni budžet se ne prenosi u sledeću godinu.

items.question: Who should hear first when my laptop has been stolen?
items.answer:
Report lost or stolen devices to security first. [hb-01-chunk-2]
Source [hb-01-chunk-2]: "Report lost or stolen devices to security first. Request a replacement laptop in IT portal under Hardware."

items.question: Kome prvo treba da prijavim ukraden laptop?

items.question: How much notice is required for a leave request and where is it sent?
items.answer:
Employees must make leave requests two weeks in advance in the HR portal. [hb-07-chunk-0]
Source [hb-07-chunk-0]: "Annual leave policy: employees get 22 days of annual leave per calendar year. Leave requests must be made two weeks in advance in HR portal."

items.question: On which weekdays and during which hours can I contact IT support?
